title: Department of Homeland Security: Evaluation of DHS' Information Security Program for Fiscal Year 2025: Ongoing Project
publisher: Department of Homeland Security Office of Inspector General
summary: DHS OIG lists the FY 2025 FISMA evaluation as an ongoing mandated review. Entity test: The later records challenge any closure assumption and block extension of the FY 2024 enterprise rating into FY 2025.
key_findings: The later annual outcome was not publicly available at capture, so the FY 2024 effective rating cannot be silently extended.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests the annual-metric and later-outcome alternatives.
Compatibility: Same department and CDM control input; the enterprise annual result and program recommendation statuses remain separate measurement systems.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: An ongoing-project listing verifies review activity, not the result, tested components, control operation, incidents, recovery, or service effects.
Independent official status records; no missing annual outcome is imputed.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
